execution.model: paired native local CNN + data-label L1 + clustered L2

l1_interaction_contract.formula: existing edge-conditioned MLP + beta * dot(q,k) / sqrt(head width)
l1_interaction_contract.scope: cloned L1 only; same equation for support and query; original model preserved

l1_interaction_updates.stochastic_comparison: Same explicit seed and dropout stream; without deterministic CUDA algorithms this does not guarantee bitwise repeatability

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.history: fresh reset; no saved optimizer moments

loss_configuration.ranking: all within-case observed/unobserved pairs exactly once per epoch
loss_configuration.donor: one fixed train-only donor per case; independent of observation class
loss_configuration.reference: both sides live; no detached ranking-reference embeddings
loss_configuration.auxiliary: global balanced CE; inverse schedule multiplicity per observation
loss_configuration.normalization: epoch objective: global pair mean and global balanced observation mean
loss_configuration.selection_metric: MRR then R@1 then negative pairwise loss
loss_configuration.query_scope: all observations; retain cases without eligible positive
loss_configuration.support: unchanged patient support and L2 policy

timing_scope.synchronized_update_seconds: Forward/loss, backward, gradient reporting/check, clipping and AdamW; excludes provider/loading, teacher fit, input hashes and evaluation
timing_scope.prefix_seconds: Provider/loading/transfer and verification, support teacher fitting and all updates; excludes cloning and before/after evaluation
timing_scope.limitation: Cold/warm loader, teacher preparation and GPU cache differ across branches; this short prefix does not establish an epoch speedup

l1_interaction_updates.interpretation: Short cloned fresh-optimizer full-objective comparison. Mechanical success is not final accuracy or CP validity; full data, loss weights and network sizes remain original.
l1_interaction_updates.schedule_scope: fresh diagnostic prefix of complete current epoch order; not saved next update
l1_interaction_updates.support_training_scope: original recorded patient episode selection; all eligible observations of each selected patient retained
